payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_6d80ecd7ccbd, pid 1747) active and blocked on a transactionid lock by session_268e458af1d0 (pid 1746), which executed the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead, holding its row lock uncommitted. Two other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_fb938b9bfd27, session_060c6d7c98c2) ran only SELECT 1 and are not blockers. Query stats show the blocking UPDATE completed once (rows=1), consistent with an uncommitted transaction holding the row lock. Indexes show only the primary key, and table stats show no vacuum/bloat signals, ruling out REDUNDANT_INDEX, VACUUM, and large-data causes. Root blocker is session_268e458af1d0; the eligible remediation is rollback of that project-owned session, which would release the lock and let the business request proceed. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
